What starts as a search for answers can quickly become a fight to understand what they're up against. From unsettling encounters and mysterious creatures to disturbing discoveries in the wilderness, the Expedition X team follows each lead deeper into the unknown. But when an investigation takes a dark turn, the biggest question is whether they're prepared for what comes next.
Watch Expedition X, S2, Episodes 12, 7, 9, 10, 2, 3 & 5 on Discovery Channel India.
